status: Implemented for offline tests; not measured in a live run
trigger: DeepSeek finish_reason is stop and the unchanged parse_action function raises ValueError
transition: Switch once on the next available model turn; do not switch back
history: Keep the invalid assistant reply, full shared message history, and current observation; add no correction prompt
environment: Continue in the same browser environment without reset or executing the invalid reply

limits.budget: Both clients use the same Budget object
limits.failed_reply: Uses one turn and its reported or reserved API cost

no_fallback_for: Output exhaustion or other non-stop finish reason
records: Record the trigger separately from an actual Sol call, plus per-model calls, actions, tokens, latency, and cost
scope: Every new task starts with DeepSeek; the default standalone baselines remain unchanged
evaluation: No training or tuning on WorkArena outcomes. Offline tests do not establish dynamic recovery performance.
configuration: This file documents the protocol; it is not a runtime configuration. The batch records its SHA256.
